text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Is this doll medieval-themed? I see, so 
that is why you invited me to this cafe...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Getting into the mood first sounds like a 
fine idea~ Since next time, I plan on 
making a slightly fantastical maid outfit.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Sooo, could I ask you to help with 
historical research again?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Well then, are there detailed 
settings? Like, what scale of mansion do 
they reside in? Their social rank? And if 
there are race settings—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, as for 'races,' I think it's easiest 
if you imagine fantasy races like elves or 
dwarves...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Even if we say the Middle Ages, that 
covers a wide span, and we'll want to 
specify the region of Europe as well. 
Creative works only gain true depth when 
blended with reality—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so sorry! There I go again, rattling 
on and on...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"It must have been confusing, right? Um, 
I'll explain things to you one by one, 
so—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Not at all~. I just need to tell you my 
living environment, social class, and 
race, right~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Umm... that maid is a ghost maid who lives 
in a haunted mansion, and—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...That is the general gist of it, but is 
any information missing?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
No, not at all. In fact, even though I 
spoke so fast, you managed to pick out all 
the essential points...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Bright-san really is incredible. Her mind 
is so sharp and precise!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
So that must be why in races too, you 
never miss the moment when it's 'now or 
never.'

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, then that means this task is also a 
form of training, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to working with you, Rob 
Roy "Trainer"-sama♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after that, Mejiro Bright steadily 
honed her talent, grasping Zenno Rob Roy's 
advice with precision in her own laid-back 
way!
